message.reasoning:
Deciding whether to buy Short Line or start an auction.

Railroads are a solid investment. Cash would remain at $984 after purchase. Rent scales with ownership.

Auctioning Short Line risks someone buying it for under $200. That would let them collect railroads cheaply. p4 and p3 have cash to bid. Reading, Penn, and B&O remain unowned.
